readings: q must follow gate-level X semantics (q is X whenever any of a, b, c, d is X)
X inputs are never exercised by the waveform, so q may be defined as 0 (or any value) for them
Zero-delay combinational: q = (a|b) & (c|d) at every instant, no transient values
q changes only after a nonzero propagation delay, so brief glitches can appear between input transitions (waveform only samples every 5 ns)
